entries.name: shoot state: work-recipes
entries.purpose: The RECIPES shoot state: the mission library (marketplace RECIPES tab) of ready-made, parameterized directives a user can launch or bottle as their own.
entries.promise: The RECIPES tab lists the builtin + saved recipes; SAVE A RECIPE opens the editor, TWEAK forks any recipe, EXPORT/IMPORT round-trip a recipe as portable JSON, and LAUNCH→RUN NOW fills a recipe's params once and dispatches a fresh kind:"task" workstream.
entries.notes: Live-proven .uiatlas/work-evidence/probe-evidence.txt (bay opens via #bb-missions, SAVE A RECIPE editor opens, LAUNCH→RUN NOW created a NEW kind:task workstream "Morning Brief"). test/recipes.test.js guards fillTask/importRecipe/exportRecipe (the launch/round-trip primitives). NOTE: the UI button→dispatch seam itself is not journey-covered — see finding routed to work-recipes lane. [downgraded to AUDITED: a routed UI-seam coverage finding is attached — the store/route is guarded but the button→dispatch seam is not.]

entries.name: shoot state: work-routines
entries.purpose: The ROUTINES shoot state: the scheduled-autonomous-run console where a user creates, previews, arms, runs-now, and manages server-owned cron jobs that fire their agent unattended.
entries.promise: CREATE ROUTINE validates + previews a schedule (server math), + ADD ROUTINE POSTs /api/cron and the job appears in ACTIVE ROUTINES; the arm control toggles the live scheduler via /api/cron/arm and RUN NOW streams a routine immediately — every displayed state reads from the authoritative GET /api/cron.
entries.notes: Live-proven .uiatlas/work-evidence/probe-evidence.txt (preview server math, ADD ROUTINE→/api/cron created+enabled, active list renders with RUN NOW). cron.api/arm/run-now tests guard the routes the console drives. [downgraded to AUDITED: a routed UI-seam coverage finding is attached — the store/route is guarded but the button→dispatch seam is not.]

entries.name: shoot state: work-tasks
entries.purpose: The TASKS shoot state: the project-board view of workstreams (one card ≡ one kind:"task" workstream), where a user queues, assigns, ships, and archives directives for their agent.
entries.promise: Opening TASKS shows exactly the kind:"task" workstreams (never chat/summon sessions) as kanban cards across TO DO / IN PROGRESS / SHIPPED; a card auto-advances to IN PROGRESS when a run fires and only reaches SHIPPED on a deliberate human ✓ SHIP.
entries.notes: Live-proven .uiatlas/work-evidence/probe-evidence.txt (kb-add→kind:task TO DO, assign→IN PROGRESS, ship→SHIPPED). J1 (scripts/qa/journeys.mjs) guards the board-truth lifecycle: rows===kind:task store, RUNNING/DONE chip===Channels.isBusy, no chat session on the board.

entries.name: ◷ACTIVE ROUTINES
entries.purpose: The ◷ ACTIVE ROUTINES console tab: shows the scheduler gate badge, SUGGEST ROUTINES, and the live list of standing jobs.
entries.promise: Clicking ◷ ACTIVE ROUTINES shows each job's next run / last result / armed state (from GET /api/cron) with RUN NOW / DISABLE / DELETE row actions.
entries.notes: Live-proven .uiatlas/work-evidence/probe-evidence.txt EVID routines-active-list: rowsRendered 1, runNowBtn true (the created routine renders with its RUN NOW action). AUDITED: tab switch not machine-asserted; cron.api/run-now guard the routes behind the row actions. KNOWN gap per EL-3.

entries.name: ✦CREATE ROUTINE
entries.purpose: The ✦ CREATE ROUTINE console tab: reveals the routine-creation form (how-it-works + name/prompt/schedule/agent + preview + ADD).
entries.promise: Clicking ✦ CREATE ROUTINE shows the create pane with a live schedule preview (server math) and the + ADD ROUTINE action.
entries.notes: Live-proven .uiatlas/work-evidence/probe-evidence.txt EVID routines-preview: server-computed next-fire times shown for "every 30m". AUDITED: the tab switch itself is not machine-asserted (cron tests drive the routes, not the console tab). KNOWN gap per EL-3.

entries.name: + ADD
entries.purpose: The + ADD button on the TASKS board: queues a new TO DO workstream (kind:"task") from the adjacent input.
entries.promise: Typing a title in #kb-in and clicking + ADD creates a kind:"task" workstream in the TO DO column, clears the input, and does not hijack the active chat.
entries.notes: Live-proven .uiatlas/work-evidence/probe-evidence.txt EVID kb-add: countBefore 0→1, cardLane "TO DO", kind "task", inputCleared true. J1 guards the resulting board-truth (rows===kind:task store) though it drives Workstreams.create directly rather than this DOM button.

entries.name: input
entries.purpose: The add-a-workstream text input on the TASKS board: holds the title for the next queued directive.
entries.promise: Typing a title and pressing Enter (or clicking + ADD) queues it as a TO DO task; the field then clears. Max 160 chars.
entries.notes: Live-proven .uiatlas/work-evidence/probe-evidence.txt (input accepted, submit created a task, input cleared). J1 covers the board lifecycle the input feeds.

entries.name: input
+ ADD ROUTINE
entries.purpose: The + ADD ROUTINE button: creates a scheduled cron job (name + prompt + schedule + agent) via POST /api/cron.
entries.promise: With a prompt and schedule filled, clicking + ADD ROUTINE POSTs /api/cron (with the browser IANA tz), the fields clear, and the new job appears in ACTIVE ROUTINES; a missing prompt/schedule is refused before any request.
entries.notes: Live-proven .uiatlas/work-evidence/probe-evidence.txt EVID routines-add-dispatch: created true, schedule "every 30m", enabled true, then active-list rows 1. cron.api.test.js guards POST /api/cron create (valid→200 with job id, unparseable→400). [downgraded to AUDITED: a routed UI-seam coverage finding is attached — the store/route is guarded but the button→dispatch seam is not.]

[downgraded to AUDITED: a routed UI-seam coverage finding is attached — the store/route is guarded but the button→dispatch seam is not.]

entries.name: + ADD A ROUTINE
entries.purpose: The + ADD A ROUTINE empty-state CTA: when no routines exist, jumps the console to CREATE ROUTINE and focuses the name field.
entries.promise: Clicking + ADD A ROUTINE activates the CREATE ROUTINE tab and focuses #rt-name so the user can start the first routine.
entries.notes: Verified live the CREATE form + tabs are reachable (EVID routines-view: tabCreate/tabActive present). The empty-state CTA only shows with zero jobs; not exercised after a job existed in the probe. AUDITED: navigation-only affordance, no dedicated assertion — KNOWN gap per EL-3.
